title: AI Forward Deployed Engineer
subtitle: A 3-week course on taking an AI agent from pilot to production for a client
hero_modules: The FDE role, and a first agent

blurb: Build one client project end to end: a claims agent that's evaluated, durable, secured and deployed, then handed over. Follows the syllabus of Ed Donner's AI FDE course.
